sources: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 232282 (public search API)

values.note: Single site $29 a night, double $58 (FS page, status table, and recreation.gov 2026 and 2027). One vehicle included; $8 per extra vehicle per night. Campers are also 'subject to Brainard Lake Recreation Area fees' (amount not posted on the FS pages); a Pawnee reservation stands in for the area's timed-entry ticket.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/pawnee-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night Double Site: $58 per night'; 'Pawnee Campground visitors are subject to Brainard Lake Recreation Area fees', updated September 14, 2026) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('Pawnee | 47 | 100' | Reserve now | $29/58') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232282/rates (Peak Season 2026 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29, double 58) + notices ('Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night'; 'Visitors with a Pawnee Campground reservation do not need to purchase a timed ticket to enter'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/pawnee-campground ('Not provided: electricity, hook-ups, dump stations, or showers') + recreation.gov notice ('No RV water connections are available'), read 2026-10-26

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/pawnee-campground ('Picnic tables, fire grates, water, vault toilets, and trash services are provided. Not provided: electricity, hook-ups, dump stations, or showers'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232282 ('Vault toilets and drinking water are provided'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 47 sites, eight of them tent-only in the catalog. Catalogued RV spurs mostly 48 ft; a few pull-throughs at 45-100 ft; one reservable site 20 ft. Book a site that fits: you may not move to another (but snow drifts can force a move until mid-July).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/pawnee-campground ('a total of 47 campsites for tents, campers, trailers, or RVs') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('Pawnee | 47 | 100'') + per-site catalog (45 sites: 37 standard, 8 tent-only; Max Vehicle Length 20-100, 14 at 48 ft; Pull-Through at 45, 60, 90 x3, 100) + recreation.gov notices ('You may not move to another campsite'; 'Due to the unpredictable snow drifting you may be moved to another site at Pawnee Campground up until mid-July'), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Boulder Ranger District Campground Status: 'Pawnee | 47 | 100' | Reserve now | $29/58 | June 26 - Sept 13'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Recreation.gov for the 2026 season June 26 - Sept 12 (2027: June 25 - Sept 11), closing 1 day before arrival; 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday-weekend minimums. A few sites are first-come, admitted only from 2 p.m. and not guaranteed. Do not arrive before 2 p.m.: there is nowhere to wait or turn around. A reserved site not occupied within 26 hours goes first-come.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232282 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 1 'day(s) prior to arrival'; no maxStay rule; notices quoted) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-06-26 to 2026-09-12, 2027-06-25 to 2027-09-11) + per-site catalog (9 of 45 Not Reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/pawnee-campground ('First come, first served site admittance is not accepted until 2 p.m. daily and sites cannot be guaranteed'), read 2026-10-26

note: Boulder RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF: 10,400 ft in spruce-fir forest on the east side of Brainard Lake in the Brainard Lake Recreation Area, at the foot of the Continental Divide beside the Indian Peaks Wilderness; about 4.5 mi up Brainard Lake Road from CO-72 at Ward. Parking is limited to the campground during a stay; trailhead lots need a separate timed ticket. Expect cold, wet weather at any time. --Claude
summary: Fees $29 confirmed (FS, status table, rec.gov 2026/2027); added the Brainard Lake Recreation Area fee mention to the fee note. flags: Length: the stored 100 is the forest status table's 'Max Spur 100'' and matches the catalog's longest pull-throughs (90 x3, 100); most catalogued RV spurs are 48 ft. Kept 100, but it may be a placeholder echoed into the table.
